description: This file is a PHP source code that implements the user management view in a web-based testing project. It includes functions for initializing environment, fetching user data, building user tables, and handling user disable operations. The main script orchestrates these functions to generate the user management interface.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class for rendering Ext-JS-based dynamic tables within the UI, used to display user data matrices.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing user entities, with methods to read from database and set active status.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment parameters, processes request variables, sets up GUI context.

methods.name: getRoleColourCfg
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for role colors, adding default for undefined roles.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Builds an Ext-JS rich table for displaying users with sortable columns and user interaction.

methods.name: checkUserOrderBy
methods.description: Validation function for user ordering input.

methods.name: getAllUsersForGrid
methods.description: Query function to collect user data from database for grid display, with data formatting and localization.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to manage users.
